title: A Tree-Based Localized Reduced Basis Method for Parametrized Parabolic PDEs
summary: We propose a localized reduced basis method for parametrized parabolic partial differential equations based on an adaptive partitioning of the parameter domain using hierarchical binary trees. A POD-Greedy procedure is employed to construct reduced spaces associated with each parameter subdomain. A certified \emph{a posteriori} error estimator is derived from an inf-sup stability analysis and shown to be equivalent to the underlying approximation error. This equivalence, together with suitable regularity assumptions on the parameter-to-solution map, enables a rigorous convergence analysis…
